# SOFOF TECH IT FARM

> SOFOF TECH IT FARM is an elite software engineering company and AI innovation collective based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, delivering enterprise web systems, high-concurrency mobile apps, generative AI agents, and autonomous software QA harnesses to clients worldwide across Saudi Arabia, North America, and Europe.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: SOFOF TECH IT FARM (Sofof Tech Ltd.)
- **Headquarters**: EDB Trade Centre, 93 Kazi Nazrul Islam Ave, Dhaka 1215, Bangladesh
- **Contact Email**: info@sofoftech.com
- **WhatsApp / Phone**: +880 1782-037090
- **Website**: https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/
- **Team Size**: 25+ specialized in-house engineers, architects, designers, and SQA leads.
- **Operating Philosophy**: Zero-delay asynchronous communication, transparent sprint delivery, 4+ hours daily time zone overlap with US/EU/GCC clients, and 100% in-house engineering (zero third-party subcontracting).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Custom Software & Web Engineering](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/services.html): Modern architectures with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Laravel, and PostgreSQL. High-throughput APIs, distributed microservices, and multi-tenant SaaS.
- [AI & Generative Systems](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/services.html): Autonomous LLM-driven agents, RAG knowledge retrievers, multimodal computer vision models, fine-tuned embedding pipelines, and low-latency inference services.
- [Mobile App Development](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/services.html): Flutter and native iOS/Android applications, biometric authentication (fingerprint/face matching), IoT sensor synchronization, and offline-first data sync.
- [Software QA & Autonomous Test Harnesses](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/services.html): Playwright, Cypress, Jest, pytest, automated regression pipelines, load and stress testing, and zero-defect deployment gates.
- [Cloud & DevOps Architecture](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/services.html): Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP infrastructure as code, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines, and zero-downtime rolling releases.

## Flagship Projects & Case Studies
- [Qatarat Hajj Pilgrimage Fleet Logistics](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/case-studies.html): Real-time telematics, IoT tracking, and crowd movement dispatch for 2,500+ buses across Mecca, Mina, and Arafat with 99.99% uptime during peak annual pilgrimage.
- [Salam Pay Biometric Fintech POS](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/case-studies.html): Microsecond NFC payment terminals, sub-second biometric face validation, offline reconciliation, and PCI-DSS compliant payment rails.
- [Nerja AI Marketing Intelligence](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/case-studies.html): Multi-agent autonomous sales intelligence, intent signal discovery, and automated omnichannel voice/email outreach.
- [BinGi Hotel Management System](https://mejbaurbahar.github.io/sofoftech-modern/case-studies.html): Multi-property PMS, real-time inventory channel manager, dynamic pricing, and automated guest onboarding.
